drift.statement: a test imported PyYAML, a non-stdlib dependency absent on the bare CI runner, breaking ADR-0001

findings.expected: the gate and its tests import only the standard library (ADR-0001)
findings.observed: import yaml in a test; ModuleNotFoundError on the bare runner
findings.impact: green local, red CI -- the faithful-runner property is violated
findings.failure_scenario: the composed-tree gate reports green locally while CI is red
findings.recommendation_direction: remove the non-stdlib import or guard it try/except ImportError

non_coverage.reason: only the yaml import was in scope
